purpose.zh: 仰卧单膝抱胸，拉伸对侧髋前侧
purpose.en: Practise a gentle single-knee hug with the other leg resting long to lengthen the front of that opposite hip.

text.zh: 抱住一边膝盖，另一条腿放松伸直
text.en: Hug one knee, let the other leg rest straight

text.zh: 左手轻扶左小腿，左膝靠近胸口，右腿伸长承托在垫上
text.en: Hold the left shin gently with the left hand, bring the left knee towards the chest, and rest the right leg long on the mat.

text.zh: 右臂放松在体侧，头肩保持承托，不抬头追膝
text.en: Relax the right arm beside the body with head and shoulders supported, without lifting the head towards the knee.

text.zh: 随呼吸轻柔抱近再放松，不把右腿压向地面
text.en: Gently draw in and ease with the breath without pressing the right leg down.

commonErrors.zh: 猛拉左膝、抬头耸肩或憋气
commonErrors.en: Yanking the left knee in, lifting the head and shrugging, or holding the breath.

commonErrors.zh: 把右腿强压地面、过度拱腰或用样片结果自判疾病
commonErrors.en: Forcing the right leg down, over-arching the lower back or using the demonstration to self-diagnose a condition.

items.zh: 髋与膝：左侧抱膝只用轻柔拉力，右腿自然承托，不向两端硬拉。
items.en: Hips and knees: use a gentle left-knee hug and let the right leg rest naturally without forcing the limbs apart.

items.zh: 腰背与颈：头肩自然放松，呼吸顺畅，不通过拱腰或抬头增加幅度。
items.en: Lower back and neck: relax the head and shoulders and breathe comfortably without arching the back or lifting the head to gain range.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制仰卧、单侧髋深屈曲或对侧髋伸展时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if supine exercise, deep single-hip flexion or opposite-hip extension has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: The left knee is hugged while the right long leg/hip is the lengthened side. The 8-second source shows two gentle breath-led draw-and-ease cycles with no switch. Preserve default 30 seconds; proposed per-side timed breathing movement versus the legacy hold label needs editorial confirmation. It is not a 30-second fixed pose or a validated diagnostic test. Opposite-side media is not produced.
definition.movementSides: Left hand hugs left knee/shin; right leg stays long and right arm rests on the mat. StartingSide right denotes the lengthened front of the right hip. Optional boundary only after the side dose; no in-clip change or mirrored media.
editorialNotes: 名称沿当前目录去掉测试宣称，英文采用HipLab已有通用名；稳定ID n-thomas-test保留，不将源历史注释的短缩判读当作经验证自测结论。此媒体是动作示范，不能凭大腿抬起诊断原因。
startingSide=right指长腿/受拉伸髋前侧，left是抱膝侧；右臂放在垫上，只有左手抱左小腿，不能写成双手抱同膝。
默认30保持数值；按unilateral示范提出每侧30秒轻柔呼吸活动，旧源并非30秒固定pose，确切hold/动态处方须编辑审定。source8秒只右髋前侧、2次轻柔抱松，不每loop强制换侧。
h-knee-hug是双膝抱胸、下背/臀部目标不同的非等价替代候选，不算本动作屈髋肌拉伸的直接降阶/进阶；同模式独立关系未核定。
相位来自catalog/v2/batches/b003.json真实源时间；剂量数字与范围保持旧catalog。rhythm只描述动画，不使用旧reps或holdSeconds来覆盖处方。
具体双语注意、通用禁用筛查、协同肌群与关系均为待审草稿；协同包含稳定/次要拉伸角色，不是额外高亮或肌电激活结论。
关系均为本仓库真实ID候选，不等于已有同模型可发布v2包；不得自动回退弃用模型素材。空关系缺口见逐动作说明。
通用医学筛查证据边界沿用catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md的AAOS/NHS一手资料；不编造疾病特异绝对禁忌，编辑/医学审核均保持pending。
